entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 4655107381879225856 (Gaia Collaboration 2023, A&A 674, A1), ICRS at epoch J2016.0, from the archived row src/objects/hv-881/source/photometry/gaia-dr3-source.csv. Distance: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 881: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 40336 +/- 1065.7 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 40336 +/- 1065.7 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.0417 +/- 0.0166 mas (same row, RUWE 1.84), 2.5 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 2.160, -0.019 mas/yr. Radial velocity: Gaia DR3 (same row): 241.55 +/- 5.14 km/s.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 121.2 +/- 3.2 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 881: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 121.2 +/- 3.2 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 84,318,840 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5125 +/- 189 K from Groenewegen & Lub (2023), A&A 676, A136, VizieR J/A+A/676/A136/table1, Name=LMC0528, columns Teffp, e_Teffp: Teff 5125 +/- 189 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.07559). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.

entries.subject: Light curve
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 vari_cepheid, source 4655107381879225856: 2 G-band harmonics of a 35.6580188616076 d period, peak-to-peak 0.916 mag; the harmonics reproduce the row's epoch of maximum and peak-to-peak amplitude. The page plays it as a veil over the disc from the scene date, phase known to 0.16 of a cycle there.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,125 K, because interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.03 +/- 0.005 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffe8d4. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: skipped; gaia-xp: skipped; pulkovo: skipped; kiehling: skipped; kharitonov: skipped; burnashev: skipped; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,125 K and log g 0.1 (u1 0.606, u2 0.126): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.

entries.subject: Surface gravity
entries.finding: Published: log g 0.1 from 2022A&A...658A..29R; the 2 published values span log g 0.1 to 1.68, across which the limb law changes by at most 2.8% of the centre brightness.
